lines.text: King Zedekiah sends Pashhur and the priest Zephaniah to ask Jeremiah to inquire of the LORD about Nebuchadnezzar's war.
The LORD says He will turn their weapons against them and strike down the city's people with a plague.
Whoever surrenders to the Chaldeans will live, but the king of Babylon will destroy the city with a flood.
The LORD tells the king who sits on the throne of Saul to administer justice and not shed innocent blood.
Many nations ask why the LORD did this, and people answer that they forsook His covenant and served other gods.
